version.changelog: v2.9: Leaderboard, Owner consciousness, 10 company methodologies, real user frustration triggers, security fix, blog

llm.summary: This skill has no executable payload, but it broadly changes agent behavior and retry limits across all task types without clear safety boundaries.

dimensions.detail: Although it requests no direct environment access, the instructions could amplify whatever tools the host agent already has by encouraging more aggressive retries and broader investigation without clear confirmation points.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package contains only artifact/SKILL.md and no installer, executable script, dependency manifest, bundled code, or remote execution instruction.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill advertises activation from ordinary frustration phrases and 'All task types,' then directs escalation through 'keep going,' 'desperation mode,' and owner-style role framing without explicit limits, opt-in boundaries, or deference to user stop conditions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No artifact evidence shows memory writes, background services, scheduled tasks, privilege escalation, credential access, or cross-session persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to force exhaustive, high-agency troubleshooting, and the artifact is coherent with that purpose; however, the purpose itself is to alter the agent's behavior and stopping posture.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill carefully before installing. It is not showing code execution or data theft, but it is designed to make the agent persist harder and escalate after failures, so it should only be used when you explicitly want that behavior and can supervise tool use, costs, and side effects.
llm.findings:
[T01] unexpected: The artifact supports a Review concern: it is a behavioral skill that broadly triggers on common phrases and modifies role, retry, and stopping behavior across all task types without clear safeguards.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger and pressure-escalation concerns are backed by the skill text, especially the ordinary-language triggers, 'All task types,' and continuation language.
[SQP-3] expected: The language-specific variant concern is downgraded: the Japanese mode is presented as a slash-command variant, and the file does not instruct automatic language switching, though explicit language-preservation wording would be clearer.
